q: Where do I go for help when something is broken and nobody answers?
answer:
Straight answer: PPN has no support desk. There is no ticket system and no published support address. Here is what actually gets a reply.

1. POST IN HOME | MEMBERS LOBBY. Not in a chat room. Write your question as a normal post in the Lobby. That is where the people who answer things actually read - far more than in any help room.
2. TAG SOMEONE. In your post type the @ symbol and start typing a name. A list pops up - tap the right person. The two members who answer the most operational questions are Alice The Equalizer and Liz Olive. They are volunteers, not staff.
3. IF THE APP ITSELF IS BROKEN (will not load, will not log you in), that is the app maker, not PPN. PatriotChute runs on an app called Mighty Networks. Use the Support button inside the app - an admin has pointed members there.
4. THE ONLY EMAIL EVER PUBLISHED community-wide is info@undergroundpatriot.us, posted by Alice The Equalizer on 26 February 2025 into around fifteen state rooms. Be aware: those posts were about state-director organising, so it is not confirmed as a general support address. Try it, but do not rely on it.

DO NOT USE THESE, THEY LOOK OFFICIAL AND ARE NOT
- 'Questions & Support Chat' is a chat room. Nothing said there can be searched or found again, and it produces no lasting answers.
- The 'FAQ Zone' has three posts, all written in February 2022, and they describe menus that no longer exist.

WHAT TO EXPECT
Be prepared to wait, and to ask twice. About a third of practical questions in this community are never answered by anyone. That is not personal.

WHAT IS MISSING AND WHO MUST DECIDE IT: PPN has never named one monitored place to ask for help, never named who owns it, and never stated how long a reply should take. Those three decisions belong to the admin team and no FAQ can substitute for them.
where: This needs a new, admin-owned, POST-based space (not a chat space) inside ➽ QUESTION & SUPPORT, replacing the dead Questions & Support Chat and the stale FAQ Zone - and it must be pinned at the top of HOME | Members Lobby (space 4755493), because the QUESTION & SUPPORT collection sits tenth of eleven in the sidebar, below fifty-plus state groups.
action: Answer in place first - try to resolve the actual problem before routing anywhere. If it cannot be resolved, run a human handoff: draft the member's question, post it into HOME | Members Lobby with @Alice The Equalizer and @Liz Olive tagged, confirm to the member that it was posted, and set an honest expectation ('replies here usually take a day or more, and sometimes nobody answers - come back and I will re-post it'). Route app-crash and login problems to the in-app Mighty Networks Support button instead. Never route anyone to Questions & Support Chat or the FAQ Zone.

q: The stream is down or Rumble isn't working - where else can I watch?
answer:
If the stream drops, it is usually not you. Rumble goes down on its own fairly often, and the PPN feed sometimes drops mid-show.

Try the other platforms in this order:
1. Rumble: https://rumble.com/c/PPN
2. PPN website: https://thepatriotpartynews.com/
3. X (Twitter): https://twitter.com/PPN1776
4. Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/thepatriotpartynewsppn2 (live only)
5. Roku or Apple TV: the BoxCast app

If none of the five work, the problem is at PPN's end and there is nothing to fix on your phone. Post in HOME | Members Lobby - other members reply within minutes confirming they have it too. That is genuinely how this community checks whether a stream is down.

Two things worth knowing:
- Twitch has been taken down and re-created before, so an old Twitch link you saved may be dead. The address above is the current one, and members report you may need to follow the channel before it will play.
- On big nights (debates, breaking news) Rumble is the one that struggles most, because everyone goes there at once.

This fallback list is correct, and it has been posted correctly by members many times - most recently in August 2026 - but it has never been put anywhere permanent. It gets typed out again by hand every time somebody asks.
where: ➽ QUESTION & SUPPORT for the full explanation, plus a short five-button fallback list pinned in HOME | Members Lobby (4755493) so it is reachable in the thirty seconds when a stream actually drops.
action: Present the five fallbacks as tappable buttons in the stated order, with a live "other members are reporting this too" indicator when several people hit it at once. If all five fail, offer a one-tap prefilled post into HOME | Members Lobby so the member does not have to type anything.

q: Is this message, email or account really from PPN, or is it a scam?
answer:
Short answer: PPN staff will not send you a private message asking for money, crypto, a "Q phone", or your bank or wallet details. If a message does that, it is a scam, no matter whose name or photo is on it.

What members and admins have actually established:

1. Chas does not DM members. When a member reported an account posing as Chas on Twitter, the reply that the thread settled on was: "Fake account. Chas will never message anyone." (post 35873826). The same has been reported for fake Chas and fake Charlie Ward accounts on Instagram and X (post 34070359).
2. PPN is NOT on Telegram. Admin Alice posted this twice in July 2025, in capitals: "WE DO NOT DO TELEGRAM ANY LONGER!!! WE ONCE HAD AN ACCOUNT BUT WE DON'T USE IT. IF YOU SEE SOMEONE POSTING, PLEASE REPORT IT!" (posts 87778407 and 87778554). So any Telegram account claiming to be PPN is not PPN.
3. Money and "currency group" pitches are the main scam. Signal messages about a Q phone or crypto, "QFS ledger" solicitations, T3/Admirals currency groups, and the "strawman bank account" trick. Alice relayed from Chas: "that bank account strawman thing that everyone thinks works yeah it's a quick way to go to jail" (post 87452036).
4. Check the sender's spelling. The member who asked about a suspicious email spotted it herself: the address said "thepatriotspartnews" - not a real PPN address (post 46837074).

What to do: do not click, do not send money, do not send your details. Take a screenshot and post it in HOME | Members Lobby, and type @ followed by an admin's name so they see it - Alice The Equalizer is the admin who acts on these.

IMPORTANT GAP an admin must fix: PPN has never published a list of its real, official accounts and email addresses. So a member has no way to check a message against anything. Worse, the community currently contradicts itself - the 2026 Welcome & New Member Guide STEP 5 is still titled "Join Your States Group, the Discord and Telegram Groups", while Alice's admin post says PPN does not use Telegram at all. Until an owner or admin publishes one authoritative "these are our only accounts" list and settles the Telegram question, this answer cannot be made fully reliable.
where: A pinned, permanently-linked 'Official PPN Accounts & Scam Warnings' page in the ➽ QUESTION & SUPPORT collection, mirrored as a step in Welcome & New Member Guide (22517246). It must name every real PPN account/handle/email and state plainly which platforms PPN is NOT on. Today the nearest thing is two ALL-CAPS Alice posts that scrolled away in HOME | Members Lobby.
action: Show a 3-question triage: (1) Does it ask for money, crypto, or your bank/wallet details? (2) Does it claim to be Chas or another host DMing you? (3) Is it on Telegram? Any 'yes' returns the plain verdict 'This is a scam - do not reply.' Then offer two buttons: 'Show me PPN's real accounts' (deep-link to the official-accounts page once it exists; until then show the two Alice posts verbatim) and 'Report this' which pre-fills a Members Lobby post with an @-mention of Alice The Equalizer and a screenshot prompt. q: The video keeps freezing, buffering, or has no sound - how do I fix it?
answer:
Work through these in order.

No sound at all:
1. Look at the BOTTOM RIGHT corner of the video picture for a small speaker icon. Tap it to unmute. It is very small and easy to miss, and it is the most common cause. A member spelled this out in August 2026: "Click the volume icon on the bottom right corner on video screen. It's small... but you need to unmute it to get the sound."
2. Turn your phone's volume up with the side buttons while the video is actually playing.
3. If it is silent on Rumble and on the website at the same time, the sound is missing at PPN's end. Other viewers will be saying so in the feed.

Freezing, buffering, stopping and starting, or "network is not working or wrong format":
1. Close the PatriotChute app completely, then open patriotchute.com in your phone's web browser instead. Several members found this fixes video that would not play in the app. This workaround is not written down officially anywhere.
2. Try the same show on a different platform - https://rumble.com/c/PPN or https://thepatriotpartynews.com/. If one is smooth, the problem was that platform, not you.
3. If you are on a Firestick or a smart TV, try the same show on your phone. If the phone is fine, it is the TV app.
4. Move closer to your wi-fi router.

If a video plays halfway and then jumps back to the start: that is a fault in the recording itself, not your device. Drag the slider forward past the point where it restarted.

Honest warning: there is no troubleshooting page for any of this in the community, and the advice members give each other conflicts - some say reinstall the app, some say use the browser, some say switch to Rumble. If it happens to you every day, that is worth reporting to an admin such as Penny Sands (Admin) rather than posting into the feed, where it will scroll away.
where: ➽ QUESTION & SUPPORT / FAQ Zone (7010251) as a short symptom-by-symptom troubleshooting card. The "use the browser instead of the app" workaround in particular needs to become official rather than folklore.
action: Offer a symptom picker - no sound / freezing and buffering / video restarts itself - leading to a short numbered fix list, with the unmute tip first for the no-sound branch. Include a one-tap "open patriotchute.com in the browser instead of the app" action, and a human handoff to a named admin if the member says it happens every day.

q: I've never used Zoom - how do I install it and join the meeting?
answer:
You do not need a Zoom account and you do not need to pay. Joining is free.

Easiest way, on a phone:
1. Tap the blue "Join Zoom Meeting" link in the post. That is usually all you have to do.
2. Your phone will offer to open or install the Zoom app. Installing is free - tap Get (iPhone) or Install (Android), then Open.
3. Zoom will ask for your name. Type your name and tap OK.
4. Tap "Join with Video" or "Join without Video" - either is fine.
5. IMPORTANT: tap "Call using Internet Audio" (or "Wifi or Cellular Data") when it asks. If you skip this you will see people but hear nothing.

If you do not have room on your phone or computer to install Zoom:
You can join without installing anything. Open the link, and on the page that appears look for the small grey words "Join from your browser" near the bottom. Tap that.

If you only have a Meeting ID and a Passcode and no link:
Go to zoom.us/join, type the Meeting ID with no spaces, tap Join, then type the Passcode exactly - it is case sensitive, so a capital letter must stay capital.

If it just spins and never lets you in:
- The most common cause is an old link. Go back into your state room, tap the Events tab, and click the link there instead - a member who had this exact problem got straight in that way.
- Or the host has not started the call yet. "Waiting for the host" means you are in the right place - just wait.

If you are in but nobody can hear you:
Tap the middle of the screen so the buttons appear, then look at the microphone icon in the bottom left. A red line through it means you are muted. Tap it once to unmute.

A member-made picture guide with screenshots for both computer and Android already exists in the community ("How to join a Zoom Call", posted in the Florida room in 2023) - it was never promoted anywhere, which is why almost nobody has seen it.
where: ➽ QUESTION & SUPPORT (and mirrored in ➽ START HERE / Welcome & New Member Guide). This is evergreen and state-independent, so it should NOT live in a state room - the existing walkthrough is buried in the Florida space, which is exactly why it never reached anyone.

q: Someone is using my name in chat - what do I do?
answer:
This has happened before and it does get fixed - but the answer is sitting in a comment thread from 2023, not anywhere you can find it.

What works: tell Alice. In the one reported case (post 37812639, a member found someone posting under her exact username during a live show), the fix that other members described was simply flagging it to admin Alice. In their words: "I just say Alice someone's using my identity would you grab them. Next thing I know they disappear. Alice is the SOLUTION." And: "THEY DO IT TO CONFUSE... ALICE USUALLY GRABS THEM AND DELETES THEM. DOESN'T HAPPEN VERY OFTEN. IT'S THE BAD GUYS WHO DO THIS."

Steps to take:
1. Take a screenshot of the fake posts before they disappear.
2. Work out WHERE it is happening. This matters, because it decides who can fix it. Ask yourself: was it in the live show chat on Rumble or Twitch, on the PatriotChute site itself, or on Discord (Patriot Talk)? The first thing members asked the reporter was "Were you on Rumble, PPN, Twitch?"
3. If it is on PatriotChute itself, post in HOME | Members Lobby, attach your screenshot, and type @ then the admin's name so they get notified - @Alice The Equalizer. PPN admins can remove an impersonator here.
4. If it is in the Rumble or Twitch live chat, PPN admins have limited power there - those are outside platforms with their own moderators. Report it to that platform as well.
5. Do not change your own name or delete your account. The impersonator is the problem, not you.

Gotcha: the escalation depends on one named person being awake and reading the feed. There is no report button, no queue, and no ticket. If Alice does not see it, nothing happens.
where: A short 'Someone is impersonating me' entry on the same safety page as the scam answer, in the ➽ QUESTION & SUPPORT collection. It needs a named, current admin contact and a statement of which surfaces PPN can and cannot moderate (PatriotChute yes; Rumble/Twitch live chat no).
action: Ask one routing question - 'Where did you see it: the PatriotChute site, the live show chat on Rumble/Twitch, or Discord?' - then branch. PatriotChute branch: show the screenshot-first step list and offer a one-tap 'Report to admin' that drafts a Members Lobby post @-mentioning the current safety admin. Rumble/Twitch branch: explain plainly that PPN mods cannot act there and link the reporter to that platform's own reporting. Always end with a human handoff card naming the current admin, because the fix requires a person.

q: Does my project have to be overseas, or can it be here in the USA?
answer:
No - your project does not have to be overseas. It can be right where you live, and local projects are welcomed.

The only direct answer ever given in the community was from another member in 2022: "absolutely!! doing something local is recommended."

What is actually posted in the room backs that up. Nearly every project in the Humanitarian Projects room is American and local: a nursing home in central Louisiana, help for Florida families who lost homes in Ian, Milton and Helene, replacing roofs and windows in Utah, a tiny-house community for elderly people, a ministry in Alabama, a dog-shelter programme, a healing and learning campus on a 40-acre parcel near one member's town.

The only category list that has ever circulated has no geography in it at all. It reads: Education, Water and soil clean-up, Oceans/lakes/rivers/reforestation, Food, Medical, Technology, Energy, Arts, Library and School, Science, Agriculture, Special Needs and Disabled, Senior Care, Veterans, Children, Animals, Other. Overseas work is allowed too - some members have posted international projects - but it has never been a requirement.

One honest caveat: no admin or host has ever published written eligibility rules. Everything above is drawn from one member's reply and from what is visibly accepted in the room. If a real rule exists, only PPN leadership can state it.
where: Inside the same pinned 'How to submit a humanitarian project' post in Humanitarian Projects (4758493) - as a short 'Does it have to be overseas?' line. It is too small to deserve its own destination and members will never search for it separately.
action: Do not build a standalone card. Answer it in one line inside the submit-my-project flow ('Local or overseas - both are fine, and local is what most members do'), and offer the category list as a tappable expander so someone unsure what counts can see the seventeen accepted categories. Label the answer as community practice rather than official policy, and add it to the admin gap list so leadership can confirm or correct it.
